newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish far-right politician shot dead.
newsitem.headline: Turkish far-right politician shot dead.

text.p: A local official of Turkey's far-right Nationalist Action Party (MHP) was shot dead on Monday on returning from early morning prayers at an Istanbul mosque, party officials said.
"Our chief was killed after early morning prayers," an official told Reuters.
Anatolian news agency named the victim as Nihat Uygun, 31, a district chairman of the MHP. The agency said Uygun was abducted near the mosque and shot dead on nearby waste ground.
The agency said a note from an outlawed left-wing organisation was found near his body but it did not name the group.

MHP supporters were involved in left-right street clashes in the late 1970s in which around 5,000 people died. The party failed to garner enough votes to enter parliament at general elections in 1995.
